name: footer-tiles
title: Footer Tiles
description: A footer as four tiles: address, opening hours with an open-now signal in the place's own time zone, links and social links.

props.name: address
props.description: The address tile: place name, address lines and a directions link.

props.name: hours
props.description: The opening hours tile: the time zone and the weekly schedule behind "open now".

props.name: links
props.description: Links tile: a short list of pages.

props.name: social
props.description: Social tile: each with an icon and text.

props.name: now
props.description: The moment to judge "open now" by. When absent the real time is used after mount and refreshed every 30 s.

a11y.text: A footer named by a screen-reader-only h2 with four tiles with an h3 each (Visit, Opening hours, Explore, Follow). Visit is an address element; directions and social links open in a new tab with hidden text and aria-hidden icons. The hours are a list with a "Today" marker in text and a status line ("Open now" or "Closed, opens ...") with an aria-hidden dot; it reads "Opening hours" until the time is known and refreshes every 30 s unless now is given.
The link fade on hover is dropped under reduced motion (motion-reduce).
